title: Google finally gives ChatGPT some competition
author: David Pierce

recommendations.name: Google Gemini
recommendations.blurb: Talking to Google CEO Sundar Pichai this week, I got the distinct sense that he sees the new Gemini model as the moment Google starts to win the AI war. Is he right? Who knows! Gemini certainly has its issues.

recommendations.name: Beeper Mini
recommendations.blurb: What a saga this was! The universal messaging app released a new app for Android that did one thing — let you send blue-bubble iMessages — and did it well. So well, it seems, that Apple quickly figured out a way to shut it down. I don’t think we’ve seen the last of this back-and-forth.

recommendations.name: The Artificial podcast series
recommendations.blurb: I think every reporter I know is currently digging into the history of OpenAI, trying to figure out how this weirdly structured organization came to be the biggest thing in artificial intelligence.

recommendations.name: Mammoth 2
recommendations.blurb: I’ve used a lot of Mastodon apps, and this is my new favorite. Mammoth is nice-looking and fast but also really devoted to helping you find good people and posts on the platform. It’s only for Apple devices, which is a bummer, but it’s a really nice app.

recommendations.name: Resident Evil 4 ’s VR Mode
recommendations.blurb: You could argue that Resident Evil games have been the best thing in VR for a long time. Now, PSVR users are getting a pretty full VR version of Resident Evil 4, which is one of the best games in the series and was remade as one of the best games of the year. I might need to buy a PSVR for this.

recommendations.name: Lego Fortnite
recommendations.blurb: I played a lot of OG Fortnite recently and actually loved the game minus all the tie-ins and branded stuff. But this is something else: a massive new island and almost an entirely new game within Fortnite. I’ve only played it a bit, but it’s very cool.

recommendations.name: Digital Foundry’s Grand Theft Auto VI trailer breakdown
recommendations.blurb: Have you watched the GTA VI trailer yet? Statistically speaking, I think everyone on earth already has. And if you’re as excited about it as I am, you’ll love this 37-minute, absurdly deep exegesis of practically every frame and pixel we’ve seen so far.

recommendations.name: Disney Plus with Hulu
recommendations.blurb: Disney’s combined streaming service is now in beta testing, which means you might start to see a Hulu tab inside of your Disney app. Fast Company has a fun story on all the unexpected challenges of shoving two services together like this, but ultimately, it looks pretty simple.

recommendations.name: Visual Electric
recommendations.blurb: A new and clever riff on AI image generation — this one gives you all kinds of dynamic control, so instead of prompting and re-prompting, you can tweak your images almost as if you’re in Photoshop.

recommendations.name: Apple iPhone 15 Pro
recommendations.blurb: The phone: Apple iPhone 15 Pro.

recommendations.name: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 5
recommendations.blurb: The phone: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 5.

recommendations.name: Backdrops
recommendations.blurb: The wallpaper: Something I found in the Backdrops app, the best wallpaper app for Android, that I thought looked cool.

recommendations.name: the Silo trilogy of books
recommendations.blurb: I’ve been reading the Silo trilogy of books about a decade late, and I’m about a third of the way through the last one, Dust.

recommendations.name: Fargo
recommendations.blurb: There’s finally a new season of Fargo airing now, and I love it.

recommendations.name: The Morning Show
recommendations.blurb: I’m extremely here for the Jon Hamm-aissance this year; he was great in the most recent season of The Morning Show, too.

recommendations.name: a MagSafe ring sticker
recommendations.blurb: I stuck a MagSafe ring sticker to the back of my Z Fold 5 a few weeks ago, and it opened up a whole world of fun accessories I can share between my iPhone and it.

recommendations.name: Dan Seifert (@danseifert) on Threads
recommendations.blurb: Grips, kickstands, chargers, and batteries all work great, but my favorite is the hack I did by gluing a second MagSafe ring to the sleeve for an S Pen, and now I have a detachable S Pen holder without a bulky case.

recommendations.name: Crokinole
recommendations.blurb: I was just introduced to the Canadian ‘board game’ Crokinole, and it’s pretty rad. The boards are the size of a small table.

recommendations.name: Omnivore
recommendations.blurb: Throwback to an earlier Installer that brought up Omnivore as a read-it-later service. I have since moved all of my newsletters (including Installer ) over to Omnivore and out of my standard email inbox.

recommendations.name: Godzilla Minus One
recommendations.blurb: Godzilla Minus One was fantastic and deserves attention from those that haven’t been traditionally interested in kaiju movies.

recommendations.name: Scott Pilgrim Takes Off
recommendations.blurb: Scott Pilgrim Takes Off is an alternative story to the original comics. The cast from its movie adaptation is back. Combine that with the anime-like animation, and you have the perfect binge-watch for the weekend.

recommendations.name: Starling Hub | Nest HomeKit Bridge | Complete Smart Home Control
recommendations.blurb: The Vergecast reminded me that this little device has connected my Nest devices to Apple HomeKit for over three years without breaking once. I forgot I even used it in my setup.

recommendations.name: Informed
recommendations.blurb: Informed. It’s a kinda new news app. Looks super clean. Articles don’t refresh as often as I’d like. Still rocking with it though.

recommendations.name: DuckDuckGo
recommendations.blurb: Using DuckDuckGo / Firefox Relay to remove trackers from emails and clean up links. Useful for newsletters or shopping websites.

recommendations.name: Wacaco Picopresso
recommendations.blurb: Been loving the espresso I’ve been making this week with my new Wacaco Picopresso.

recommendations.name: NowPlaying
recommendations.blurb: I’d like to recommend NowPlaying. This app is the most beautiful way to detect fun details about any song, album, or artist.

recommendations.name: watch the finals live tonight on YouTube
